Zara: FYI - Nova POC is hitting sporadic 429s on /v1/embeddings.batch during a dataset ingest. They9re using 4 workers and gradually increasing batch size. Demo in 2 hours, can we triage?

Owen: Ask for exact batch sizes and whether they9re using retries. Also which model.

Zara: They say batches ramped from 128 -> 768 over 15 minutes. Model=embed-xl. Tenant=novapoc-22. Client retries every 300ms (no jitter). Attached this server reply: 

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit","retry_after_ms":1000,"route":"/v1/embeddings.batch","tenant_id":"novapoc-22","tokens":110500}
```

Rita: Retry-After=1000ms but fixed 300ms retries will create a retry storm. Two immediate mitigations: 1) ask customer to pause/restart with backoff/jitter; 2) temporary per-route allowance.

Cal: Customer wants to finish the ingest today. Approve a short override if safe.

Rita: I can apply a 35-minute override: tokens_per_min=320000 for /v1/embeddings.batch and set soft_concurrency=6 for novapoc-22. Will post override id after apply.

quota-bot: [automated] Override API: POST /internal/admin/overrides {"tenant_id":"<id>","route":"<route>","tokens_per_min":<n>,"soft_concurrency":<m>,"duration_min":<d>} 1 infra approval required for concurrency adjustments.

Zara: I told them to reduce immediate batch size to 256 and add exponential backoff with full jitter (base 400ms, cap 5s) while we apply the override.

Rita: Applied override ov-20260328-58 at 14:18Z. tokens_per_min=320000 soft_concurrency=6 duration_min=35.

quota-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260328-58 applied for tenant novapoc-22 by Rita. Scheduled end 14:53Z.

Owen: Confirmed: after reducing batch size to 256 and with override, no 429s in 10m window. Follow-ups: 1) add client-side jittered backoff samples to POC playbook; 2) recommend permanent quota only if they demonstrate steady sustained traffic.

Cal: Noting temporary concession in CRM and scheduling a handoff for a technical follow-up to review quota needs.

Rita: I9ll revert 10m before scheduled end to test tolerance. Monitoring now.

quota-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260328-58 scheduled end 14:53Z.

Zara: Ingest completed at 14:30, exported sample vectors checked. Customer happy for now and will adopt backoff guidance.

Rita: Reverted override at 14:45Z; no regressions observed. Closing thread.
